svg.title: Water treatment operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as water treatment operator, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tall rounded water-filter vessel has three separated media layers and an outlet above one clean-water drop. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
